Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, Sonia Gandhi and other leaders paying tribute to former Prime Minister of Jawaharlal Nehru on his 137th birth anniversary at Shanti Van, New Delhi on November 13, 2026. | Photo Credit: Sushil Kumar Verma
Calling Jawaharlal Nehru the principal architect of modern India, the Congress on Saturday (November ) invoked the legacy of the country’s first Prime Minister, highlighting his commitment to democracy, secularism and scientific temper on his 137th birth anniversary.
Party president Mallikarjun Kharge and former party chief Rahul Gandhi recalled their contributions in building a progressive nation.
Mr. Kharge and Congress Parliamentary Party chairperson Sonia Gandhi visited Shanti Van, Nehru’s memorial, to pay their respects. Several Congress leaders, including former Rajasthan Chief Minister Ashok Gehlot , were present.
They later paid floral tributes to Nehru’s portrait in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan, the old Parliament building. Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla , Congress chief whip whip Kodikunnil Suresh, and other leaders were also present.
However, Trinamool Congress leader Derek O’Brien pointed to the absence of Union Ministers at the tribute ceremony. “We paid floral tributes this morning in Central Hall, Parliament, to India’s first Prime Minister, Pandit Nehru. Not even one of the current PM’s 29 cabinet ministers were present. Decency? Common courtesy?”he asked in a post on X.
Mr. Gandhi, in a post on X, described Nehru as the “Jewel of Hind” and said freedom was not his destination but a milestone in the country’s new journey. “India was a quest, an idea for him — diversity as its strength, democracy as its faith, and equality as its foundation,” he said.
हिंद के जवाहर, भारत के प्रथम प्रधानमंत्री पंडित जवाहरलाल नेहरू जी की जयंती पर सादर नमन। आज़ादी उनकी मंज़िल नहीं, देश के नए सफ़र का मुकाम थी। स्वराज सत्ता नहीं, हर नागरिक की भागीदारी और देश के भविष्य की ज़िम्मेदारी थी। भारत उनके लिए एक खोज, एक विचार था - विविधता जिसकी शक्ति, लोकतंत्र जिसका विश्वास और समानता जिसका आधार हो। एक आधुनिक, वैज्ञानिक, प्रगतिशील और आत्मविश्वासी भारत का उनका सपना आज भी हमारी प्रेरणा है। और उस सपने के भारत की ओर हमारा प्रयास ही उन्हें सच्ची श्रद्धांजलि है।
Mr. Kharge said Nehru understood that a country as diverse as India could remain united only through democracy that accommodated different cultures, beliefs, political voices and aspirations.
“As we pay our solemn tributes to him at Shanti Van today, we must reaffirm our resolve to preserve, protect and defend the Constitution, our democratic institutions and the values that bind us together,” he said.
Mr. Kharge also recalled Nehru’s commitment to scientific thinking, secularism and equality, and his faith in providing every citizen with equal opportunities. Nehru’s affection for children and his emphasis on their education, he said, remained a reminder that the country’s future rested with the coming generations.
Today is nehruarchive.in@1. Over the past year, this digital repository of the 100 volumes of the Selected Works of Jawaharlal Nehru covering the period 1903-1964 has had well over 1 million unique visitors and has had 4 million+ page views. The volumes run into around 77,000 pages, have 34,000+ text documents and 3000+ images. They are essential to understanding 20th century India through the eyes of someone who so very profoundly shaped it. https://t.co/FaoiVqdzvj is digitally native, smartphone-friendly, easy to search, download(free) and translate. It has been designed for a vast range of internet users, especially the younger generation. It has evoked great interest across a wide range—the general public, students and scholars, professional historians and journalists, admirers, sceptics and critics—and has been providing an authentic primary source that is already being put to use for a variety of purposes. But this is only the beginning. nehruarchive@2 will go beyond the Selected Works and be even richer and will contain vastly expanded Nehru-related material from many more sources in India and abroad including letters, photos, documents, books, films, audio recordings and cartoon sketches that appeared during his lifetime. https://t.co/FaoiVqdzvj is an initiative of the Jawaharlal Nehru Memorial Fund whose Deed of Declaration of Trust was signed on Dec 21, 1964 by the-then Vice President of India Dr. Zakir Husain and Prime Minister Lal Bahadur Shastri along with 30 other extremely distinguished men and women. Their names along with their signatures for the Deed make for fascinating reading. What a glittering galaxy that was. The Appeal by the-then President of India Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was compelling and moving. The Distorians led by the supposed MA in Entire Political Science himself will do what they have been doing to defame and denigrate Nehru. But this digital archive will be a kavach that will preserve, protect, promote and propagate his monumental legacy.
Congress communication chief Jairam Ramesh, on X, shared the interest that the digital archive of Nehru’s works generated. “Over the past year, this digital repository of the 100 volumes of the Selected Works of Jawaharlal Nehru covering the period 1903-1964 has had well over 1 million unique visitors and has had 4 million+ page views. The volumes run into around 77,000 pages, have 34,000+ text documents and 3000+ images,” Mr. Ramesh said.
“They are essential to understanding 20th century India through the eyes of someone who so very profoundly shaped it,”he added.
